title: Answer
description:
Angels, on either reading of the words, are among things made and sent. That cannot be said of the Son.

Of the ways men are called god, only the anointed king who still has a God fits the Son. A task-title and a dying judge do not.

His companions are a wedding company, not peers of an ordinary king.

The creator lines belong to the afflicted one who builds Zion, and the founding of the heavens is so that a people can be told they are his. The children continue. The heavens do not.
